description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the CalcCACS operation for coronary artery calcium scoring
description_zh: 本文介绍冠脉钙化积分测算CalcCACS的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess calc-cacs --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --data-source-type HTTP_FILES --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: CalcCACS

parameters.help_en:
The format of the image. Only `DICOM` and `NIFTI` are supported.

If the input data type is `HTTP_NII`, set DataFormat to the NIFTI image format
parameters.help_zh:
图像的格式。目前只支持`DICOM`和`NIFTI`。

当输入的数据类型为`HTTP_NII`时，DataFormat需输入NIFTI图像格式
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the input data. Valid values: `HTTP_FILES` and `HTTP_NII`.

`HTTP_FILES`: series files.
`HTTP_NII`: a single file.

If the input data type is `HTTP_NII`, URLList.N.URL must be a nii.gz file. Example: URLList.1.URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.nii.gz. A nii file is a medical imaging file that differs from a DICOM file
parameters.help_zh:
输入数据的类型，支持`HTTP_FILES`和`HTTP_NII`。

`HTTP_FILES`为序列文件。
`HTTP_NII`为单个文件。

当输入的数据类型为`HTTP_NII`时，则URLList.N.URL需要传入一个nii.gz文件，例如，URLList.1.URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.nii.gz。nii是和dicom文件不同的医学影像文件
parameters.name: data_source_type

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use Object Storage Service (OSS) URLs in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1&URLList.2.URL=url2&..., where url1 and url2 are actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate URLList
fields.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

Data.description_en:
The returned data.
After the asynchronous task is successfully executed, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh:
返回的结果数据内容。
该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Detections.description_en: The detailed list of calcified lesions

CalciumCenter.description_en: The center coordinates of the lesion in the image coordinate system [x, y, z]
CalciumCenter.description_zh: 图像坐标系下病灶中心坐标[x, y, z]

items.description_en: The center coordinates of the lesion in the image coordinate system [x, y, z]
items.description_zh: 图像坐标系下病灶中心坐标[x, y, z]

CalciumId.description_en: The sequence number of the calcified lesion, starting from 1
CalciumId.description_zh: 钙化病灶的序号，从1开始

CalciumScore.description_en: The calcium score of the lesion

CalciumVolume.description_en: The volume score of the lesion

ResultUrl.description_en: The download URL of the segmentation result. The URL is valid for 5 minutes
ResultUrl.description_zh: 分割结果下载地址，有效时间5分钟

VolumeScore.description_en: The volume score, which is the total volume of calcified spots
VolumeScore.description_zh: 体积积分，即钙化点总体积

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
